description: Combined decision-forcing connection (jiggly-greeting-crystal.md A/B, advisor-recommended bundling): (1) re-verifies D0611BA/F0611BA (06-11b: SHOTNK now output-only per decision P6-8, chain(e)/%status(1218) lock-conflict error handling added) and F0611A/F0604A (06-11/06-04: F0604A now takes an optional custCode parameter, F0611A's option 5 passes JUTOK - A-5 fix) - all four are WORKSTN/EXFMT programs, V1 compile-check only, no CALL (same established limitation as part06-screens-compile: SSH non-interactive CALL hangs against EXFMT). D0611A/D0604A DDS are unchanged from their already-confirmed part06-screens-compile compile, so are NOT recompiled here. (2) Tries 3 independent candidates for 06-12's removed OFLIND feature (docs/probes.md's part06-12-prtf-cpp-swap RNF2037 finding) in one connection so a second connection is not needed regardless of which (if any) works: T612OFA (externally described P0612A, OFLIND(*INOA) direct), T612OFB (same file, OFLIND(*IN01) numbered form), T612OFC (program-described printer file instead, OFLIND(*INOA)) - all three THROWAWAY probes (verify/part06-12-prtf-cpp-swap/src/), not shipped lesson sources. Reuses the already-compiled P0612A object (part06-12-prtf-cpp-swap, CONFIRMED SUCCESS) for candidates A/B - does not recompile it. (3) Tries both 06-14b redesign candidates WITHOUT priming (docs/probes.md's part06-14b-null SQL0204 finding, connection #14 only succeeded WITH priming): Q0614BA (src/qrpglesrc/q0614bs.sqlrpgle, dynamic-SQL cursor via PREPARE, now also exercises TIMESTAMP/VARCHAR per part06-design-v1.md:321) and Q0614BB (verify/part06-14b-null/src/q0614bb-persistent.sqlrpgle, THROWAWAY candidate 2: static cursor against a table pre-created in a persistent library via RUNSQL, not QTEMP). Q0614BB's persistent work table (W0614BP) is dropped again at the end of this same connection - it is not meant to survive past this comparison.

steps.label: VSPLPF
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/VFYSPL) OBJTYPE(*FILE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTPF FILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) RCDLEN(133) TEXT('Part 6 spooled-file text capture'))

steps.label: CAPT612OFA
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(P0612A) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)

steps.label: CAPT612OFB
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(P0612A) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)

steps.label: CAPT612OFC
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(T612OFC) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)

steps.label: CPQ0614BA
steps.cmd: CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&LIB/Q0614BA) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(Q0614BA) OBJTYPE(*PGM) COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CAPQ0614BA
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)

steps.label: PERSISTPRIME
steps.cmd:
RUNSQL SQL('DROP TABLE &LIB/W0614BP') COMMIT(*NONE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000 SQL0000)
RUNSQL SQL('CREATE TABLE &LIB/W0614BP (TOKCD CHAR(6) NOT NULL, TOKNM VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, TOKLORD DATE, TOKLTS TIMESTAMP NOT NULL)') COMMIT(*NONE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000 SQL0000)
RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/W0614BP VALUES (''C00001'', ''ACME TRADING CO'', DATE ''2026-09-05'', TIMESTAMP ''2026-09-05-08.30.00.000000'')') COMMIT(*NONE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000 SQL0000)
RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/W0614BP VALUES (''C00099'', ''NEW PROSPECT CO'', NULL, TIMESTAMP ''2026-09-20-14.15.00.000000'')') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CPQ0614BB
steps.cmd: CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&LIB/Q0614BB) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(Q0614BB) OBJTYPE(*PGM) COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CAPQ0614BB
steps.cmd: CPYSPLF FILE(QSYSPRT) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)
